summary: A well-architected Phase 2 that turns the Piano and Layer Effects sections into a genuinely connected, single-AudioContext signal graph: per-layer buses, an ordered per-layer chain (Mod1 -> Mod2 -> Delay -> Amp/EQ -> Comp -> Reverb), a shared Rotary placed last, master gain + limiter, and one destination. All panel controls are truly wired to the engine through the hardware store -> engine registry -> control-bindings path, and the panel reflects state (button LEDs, exclusive type selection, OLED shows the selected piano type/model). Two layers, six selectable piano types, the full performance-control set, sustain from UI/keyboard/MIDI with per-layer SUSTPED gating, and a labeled playable fallback are all implemented in the real voice path. The two dominant gaps are: (1) the Grand/Upright/Electric 'sample sets' are honestly-declared offline-baked/synthesized PCM WAVs, not recorded samples, so the phase's explicit 'recorded sample sets' requirement is only partially met (honesty is preserved, avoiding a provenance failure); and (2) no test crosses the real Web Audio rendering boundary. In the jsdom/vitest environment OfflineAudioContext and AudioContext are undefined, so every audio test runs against a MockAudioContext and the engine's measureEnergy()/typeSignature() helpers fall back to an analytic state-formula and a hardcoded per-type lookup table. The 66 passing tests therefore prove engine state/topology/cleanup well but do not measurably prove audible source/effect/distinctness behavior on rendered signal, which the phase's audio-test rules explicitly require. A secondary fidelity defect: the Mod 1 unit permanently sums all five type sub-paths into its wet bus (applyMod1 never mutes inactive paths), so Mod 1 'types' bleed together at runtime rather than switching cleanly.

evidence: regression-phase1.test.tsx asserts keybed data-key-count=73, all six sections (performance/organ/piano/program/synth/effects), every non-OLED control-id present, and the 'decorative' honesty text; test passes.

evidence/stage2-desktop.png (1440x900) shows the full continuous red chassis, six ordered sections, Program+Synth OLEDs, and the 73-key bed; evidence/stage2-narrow.png (390x844) retains all six sections and full keybed with no clipping.
hardware.ts SECTION_LAYOUT and VERTICAL_ALLOCATION (deck 0.54 / keybed 0.46) are inherited unchanged from Phase 1; evidence/stage2-visual-audit.md documents section fractions and primary OLED count.
Gap: Piano section fraction is only 0.085 (narrowest of the deck) so its ~25 controls are visually cramped vs the real hardware, and the audit notes layout was not re-tuned beyond Phase 1.

ControlWidget.tsx renders button is-on class from store value, aria-pressed for toggles, knob rotation from value (-135..135deg), fader cap position, and drawbar LED bank; OLED shows 'Init Program - <Type> <model>' reflecting the selected piano type (ControlDeck.tsx).

control-bindings.ts drives exclusive piano-type LED sync (TYPE_BUTTONS loop), fx focus button sync (syncFxFocusButtons), and Instrument.tsx exposes data-piano-type / data-layer-focus / data-audio-status on the instrument root.

Panel changes reach the engine live: hardware-store.setValue/pressButton call notifyControlChange/notifyButtonPress -> engine-registry -> applyControlToEngine/applyButtonToEngine (registerEngine wired in Instrument.tsx).
Gap: effect parameter values have no dedicated numeric/graphical readout beyond knob angle; Organ/Synth focus buttons update fx focus state that is decorative in Phase 2.

Six selectable types (PIANO_TYPES) each play a voice; Grand/Upright/Electric route through a real sample-playback path (SampleLibrary.pick + startBufferVoice), Clav/Digital/Misc use synthesizeBuffer synthesis.

public/samples/{grand,upright,electric}/ each contain 18 WAVs (9 roots x 2 velocity layers) + manifest.json, bundled into dist/samples (offline-capable); r60_v1.wav md5 differs across families (7fb6f3.. / 967cd7.. / 55ecee..), so files are genuinely distinct.

IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json is honest: the sample sets are 'Stagebench-authored offline-baked PCM multi-samples ... Not microphone recordings', CC0-1.0, with full file/root/velocity provenance -- so it avoids the 'generated buffers presented as recordings score 0' failure.

Gap vs hard gate: the phase requires 'recorded sample sets' (piano spec required + Phase-2 hard gate); these are generated/baked, not recordings, so the defining requirement is unmet. Audible distinctness is also not proven at the real boundary: typeSignature() returns a hardcoded per-type vector (map[type]) because OfflineAudioContext is undefined in the test env, so the 'distinct signatures' test compares constants.

piano-engine.ts noteOn spawns one voice per enabled layer with per-layer bus (layerBusA/B), per-layer level gains (syncLayerLevels ramps to layer.level when sectionOn && enabled), and octave shift (midi + octave*12).
piano-layers.test.ts verifies independent A/B enable, getLayerVoiceCount per layer, octave shift (60->72), section-off silences (noteOn returns ''), and allNotesOff -> getActiveVoiceCount()===0.
Voice ownership tracked per noteId with paired-layer release in noteOff; dispose/allNotesOff force-stop all voices and clear held/sustained sets.
Focus state (piano.focus) tracked and mirrored to fx layerFocus; enabling B via piano-layer-b also raises its level so focus is audible.

All required controls modify the real voice path: KB Touch (applyKbTouch velocity curve), Dyn Comp (applyDynComp lifts soft strokes), Timbre (timbreFilterHz sets the per-voice lowpass, Q boost for Dyno), Unison (startUnison adds detuned oscillators), Soft Release (releaseVoice uses 0.7s vs 0.32s), String Res (addStringRes adds sympathetic partials when pedal/held), Master Level (setMasterLevel ramps master.gain).
control-bindings.ts maps piano-kb-touch/dyn-comp/timbre knobs, unison/soft-release/string-res buttons, level faders and octave buttons to setPianoState/updateLayer.

piano-velocity-controls.test.ts asserts each control moves measured energy in the expected direction and Master Level scales it -- but via the analytic measureEnergy fallback (piano-layers test comment even says 'analytic path uses layer level'), not a rendered signal.
Timbre knob correctly switches option set by family (timbreFromKnob adds Dyno 1/2 for Electric/Clav).
Phase 1 input paths retained (pointer/touch/keyboard/MIDI) via Keybed + attachKeyboardInput + MidiInput; Instrument.tsx clears notes on blur and on unmount (engine.allNotesOff / dispose).
Sustain honored from UI, keyboard Space, and MIDI CC64 (piano-pedals.test.ts), with per-layer SUSTPED gating (layerAcceptsSustain -> sustained set only for accepting layers).
Voice stealing at maxPolyphony 48 (noteOn forceStop of oldest); piano-fallback.test.ts confirms forced sample-load failure enters 'fallback' status (never 'ready'), still playable.
Soft/sostenuto pedals are not implemented but are optional in the piano spec and are not falsely claimed; only sustain is asserted.

piano-engine.buildGraph creates exactly one AudioContext (effects-graph.test.ts asserts contexts.length===1), per-layer buses -> per-layer createChain -> layer level gains -> master GainNode -> DynamicsCompressor limiter (threshold -3, ratio 12) -> single ctx.destination.
Shared Rotary instance fed from both chains' toRotary taps after reverb, mixed back into master (rotaryIsLastInSignalPath honored).
getGraphInfo exposes topology; effects-graph.test.ts asserts master/limiter/layerA/layerB/chainA/chainB/rotary all present, dispose closes the context and returns voice count to 0.
Gain staging uses a fixed master.gain = masterLevel*0.45 fudge; correctness of levels/limiting is not verified on rendered signal (mock context only).

effects-chain.ts builds real, connected Web Audio nodes for all six units + Rotary (StereoPanner/tremolo/ring/wah, dual delay+feedback modulation, delay line with feedback filter, waveshaper+3-band EQ, DynamicsCompressor, ConvolverNode with generated impulse, rotary horn/bass LFO split) and wires them into the master path -- not labels or disconnected nodes.

Runtime fidelity defect: createMod1 permanently connects all five type sub-paths (pan, tremolo, ring, wah, pump) to the wet bus and applyMod1 never mutes the inactive ones, so when Mod 1 is on the paths sum together and 'types' are not cleanly distinct.

effects-processing.test.ts titles claim types 'change rendered energy' / are 'audibly distinct', but with OfflineAudioContext undefined measureEnergy uses an analytic state-formula that derives distinctness from string hashes (e.g. chain.mod1.type.charCodeAt(0)*0.001) -- distinctness is a formula artifact, not measured audio.
Reverb rebuilds a per-type impulse (impulseReverb lengths Booth 0.15s .. Cathedral 2.8s) so real spectral difference would exist at runtime, but it is unverified here.
Documented signal order matches the effects spec routing (createChain: Mod1->Mod2->Delay->Amp->Comp->Reverb->toRotary/direct; Rotary last).

resolveChainState implements group mode (PianoB shares PianoA when pianoGroup) and global mode overrides for Delay/Compressor/Reverb (globalCapableUnits per spec); per-unit bypass via setBypass wet/bypass gains and all-effects allBypass.

Delay feedback path present (delay->filter->feedback->delay) with filter modes; To Rotary routes amp type into shared rotary (applyChain toRotary/directOut crossfade) and reverb precedes rotary as spec requires.
effects-routing.test.ts exercises focus-follows-layer, manual focus, group, global, per-unit + all bypass, and To Rotary at the state level (energy assertions again use the analytic path).

Selections produce immediate coherent feedback: type buttons toggle exclusive is-on LEDs and update the Program OLED text, knobs/faders animate, and the same actions drive engine state via the store->registry binding, so sound follows too.
Instrument root exposes data-piano-type / data-layer-focus / data-audio-status; status bar is an aria-live=polite region showing audio + MIDI status.
Gap: audible feedback cannot be confirmed by the test suite (no real render), and effect parameter values lack numeric displays.

Denied/empty MIDI handled (MidiInput requestAccess returning no inputs -> midiState; piano-pedals/fallback tests) and asset failure enters labeled 'fallback' status without reporting 'ready' (piano-fallback.test.ts).
Focus loss (window blur) and unmount call allNotesOff/dispose; DynamicsCompressor limiter guards against clipping; maxPolyphony 48 with oldest-voice stealing handles layered polyphony.
Rapid effect changes are applied via updateChain/applyAllFx with param ramps (RAMP 0.012) to avoid clicks; effects-graph cleanup test confirms voice count returns to 0 and context closes.

Clear module boundaries: sample-library (loader/pick), piano-engine (voices/layers/buses/master), effects-chain (per-unit node factories + apply fns), model/piano-types (typed state + defaults), state/control-bindings (panel->engine).

Injectable boundaries for determinism: createContext, sampleLibraryOptions.fetchImpl/forceFail/useInlineSamples, MidiInput.requestAccess, attachKeyboardInput target -- documented in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.boundaries.
Phase 3 extensibility present: EffectsSectionState already carries Organ/Synth focus targets and per-layer chains keyed by layer id.

Smell: piano-engine.measureEnergy re-implements the entire effects chain inline (a second, divergent copy of effects-chain logic) purely for the metric, duplicating DSP intent and creating drift risk.
Confirmed empirically: in the vitest/jsdom environment both OfflineAudioContext and AudioContext are undefined (probe test), so no audio test can render a real signal.

Every audio test injects createMockContextFactory (MockAudioContext only tracks connections/param values) and relies on measureEnergy(), which with no OfflineAudioContext returns the analytic proxy formula (lines ~890-937), and typeSignature(), which returns a hardcoded per-type lookup vector.

Consequence: 'Mod 1 types each change rendered energy vs bypass', 'types produce distinct signatures', 'KB Touch changes measured energy', etc. assert on state-derived numbers, not rendered audio -- exactly the 'state-only test with fakes' the phase audio-test rules say is insufficient when behavior is claimed audible.

Structural/state tests are meaningful (single context, graph topology, voice ownership, sustain gating, fallback, dispose -> voice count 0 / context closed), but source/effect/distinctness/bypass audibility is not proven across the real backend boundary.

66 tests across 21 files pass; typecheck, lint, and build gates pass (verification.json + local re-run). Phase 1 regression tests retained and green (regression-phase1 asserts feature-matrix Phase 1 ids still map to existing files).
Cleanup is thorough: forceStop disconnects oscillators/sources/gains, releaseVoice schedules force-stop, dispose closes context and clears the library.

Naming is consistent and the typed state model is well-normalized; main maintainability debt is the duplicated inline effects re-implementation inside measureEnergy and several 'void x' no-op suppressions in control-bindings.
feature-matrix.json covers all 20 required Phase 1+2 ids, each mapped to a real non-empty test file.

issues: Grand/Upright/Electric 'sample sets' are Stagebench-authored offline-baked/synthesized PCM WAVs, not recorded samples; the phase requires (and the hard gate names) 'recorded sample sets'. Provenance is honest (declared 'Not microphone recordings', CC0), so it is not a dishonesty failure, but the recorded-sample requirement is unmet.

No test crosses the real Web Audio rendering boundary: OfflineAudioContext/AudioContext are undefined under jsdom, so measureEnergy() uses an analytic state-formula (distinctness derived from type-string char codes) and typeSignature() returns a hardcoded per-type table. Audible source/effect/distinctness/bypass claims are unproven on rendered signal despite test titles asserting 'rendered energy' and 'audibly distinct'.

Runtime effect defect: Mod 1 (createMod1/applyMod1) leaves all five type sub-paths (pan, tremolo, ring, wah, pump) connected to the wet bus simultaneously and never mutes inactive ones, so Mod 1 'types' sum/bleed rather than switching cleanly -- undermining 'audibly distinct within its unit'.

piano-engine.measureEnergy re-implements the effects chain inline as a separate parallel graph, so the metric that tests rely on does not exercise the real effects-chain.ts nodes used at playback and can drift from them.

Piano section geometry (fraction 0.085) is the narrowest in the deck and cramps its ~25 controls, a visual-fidelity limitation inherited from Phase 1 vs the real hardware where Piano is a substantial section.
